messages:
leah: Quick sync on the new Export Presets modal. Goal: simplify choices & make presets non-surprising for people exporting vectors at scale. Sketch in Figma linked below.
tom: Love it. A couple things I noticed: the left column of presets reads like a settings page. Could we make each preset a compact card with a short one-line summary and a chevron for details?
evan: Cards make sense. For keyboard users, pressing Enter on a card should open the details panel and set aria-expanded. Also consider aria-describedby to show the one-line summary to screen readers.
maria: One-line summary examples: "CSV • ids • normalized" or "Parquet • include-metadata • zstd". We should cap the summary to 3 tokens.
sam: Microcopy: header text — "Download vectors" vs "Export vectors"? "Download" feels more familiar to users, but "Export" is consistent with other console spots.
leah: I lean "Download vectors" for the modal header. Primary CTA = "Download". Secondary CTA = "Apply (session)" and overflow = "Save as preset". That keeps persistence explicit.
tom: Accessibility: add role="listbox" to the preset column and role="option" for each card so screen readers can navigate. When a preset is applied, announce via aria-live polite: "Preset 'Compact CSV' applied. 3 export settings changed." evan: Also add keyboard shortcut tip in the footer: "Press P to cycle presets" — but only if it doesn't conflict with existing shortcuts. Maybe add a small helper text, not global.
maria: Preview pane: show a single sample row with ellipses for long fields; add a toggle: Sample / Full. For full preview, show the metadata fields and a collapsed vector blob ("[vector truncated]").
sam: Edge-case: preset may require specific vector dims/quant. Show inline validation under the preset name: red warning if incompatible, with a suggested action: "Convert vectors to 512-d via Optimize -> Quantize".
leah: Per-row actions: keep "Download row" in the row menu but label it "Download row (ignores preset)" when a preset is active. Also make it secondary styling to discourage accidental use.
tom: Small interaction detail: when user clicks "Apply (session)", focus should stay on the Apply button and we should show a non-modal confirmation pill: "Applied 'Compact CSV' — Undo". Focus returns to the preset card.
evans: Suggestion for the preset diff: when hovering a preset show a tiny diff popover listing changed fields so users know what will change before applying.
maria: Copy tweaks: use verbs sparingly. Buttons: "Apply" not "Apply preset settings". Overflow menu: "Save as preset..." (opens save modal). Help text: "Downloads are generated from your workspace; files leave Redwood only when downloaded." Put link to docs.
sam: QA checklist: dimension mismatch, huge export (streaming + cancel), delimiter edge cases, filename sanitization, and permission check for workspace exports.
figma-bot: prototype: https://figma.com/file/abc - updated 2026-03-22. prototype version: export-presets-v1.6
leah: Action items:
- Update modal header & CTA copy to "Download vectors" / "Download" / "Apply" (maria)
- Convert preset list to cards with 1-line summaries + diff popover (tom + evan)
- Implement role=listbox/option and aria-live announcements (evan)
- Sample/Full toggle in preview, collapsed vector display (maria)
- Inline preset validation for dims/quant and suggested fix link (sam)
- Per-row download label + de-emphasize styling (tom)
- Add footer helper text about data residency & link to docs (leah)
leah: Please react with :thumbsup: if you’re good with these and I’ll push the Figma update.
